name: WA-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: Prediction markets price DelBene at ~96% to win
Incumbency advantage with no serious outside spending
model.rationale: DelBene holds a D+15 district with a huge financial edge and no meaningful opposition spending, while markets price her near-certain to win. The fundamentals point to a Safe D race with a margin in the low twenties.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a much tighter race or unexpected outside spending against DelBene would be the main signal to revisit.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Suzan DelBene seeks re-election in a Seattle-area district that leans Democratic by about fifteen points. She has raised over $3.5 million and holds more than $1.1 million on hand, while Republican Mary Silva has raised only a few thousand dollars. No outside groups are spending against the incumbent, and no expert raters flag the race as competitive.

Prediction markets give DelBene roughly a 96% chance of winning, and the district's fundamentals point to a comfortable margin in the low twenties. With no public polling available, the forecast rests on the district's partisan lean, incumbency, and the lopsided money advantage, all of which favor DelBene decisively.
